periodRule.terra-only-estimated: before Aqua: Terra-only MODIS x Terra->Terra∪Aqua factor
periodRule.viirs-estimated: region: quantile mapping of the VIIRS reference (day + night) to MODIS any-time; AOI: region estimate x AOI share of the VIIRS reference

selection.rule: Quantile mapping if its leave-one-year-out monthly MAE is strictly lower than the stratified ratio's; otherwise the stratified ratio. Written down before the v2 fits but after the v1 Iberia results had been seen (not pre-registered in the strict sense). The same held-out errors choose and describe the method; the nested score (selection repeated inside each outer fold) estimates the whole procedure without that reuse.

qm.basis: x = VIIRS reference day + night cell-days (S-NPP scale), m = MODIS any-time cell-days, whole-region training months with complete coverage

interval90.note: Multiplicative bounds from held-out (leave-one-year-out, all parameters refitted per fold) residuals of the selected method, region-scale monthly totals; small AOIs add Poisson sampling noise (z·sqrt(estimate)).

viirsLevel.basis: VIIRS reference any-time cell-days on the S-NPP scale where a full VIIRS month exists; otherwise MODIS-equivalent x training ratio for the month of year (estimated)

coverage.rule: A satellite-day is flagged only from the detection records: 'gap' when it recorded < 10% of the detections expected from another satellite observing the same day (expected = that satellite's detections x the median ratio between the two over the surrounding ±45 days; at least 100 expected), or, with no second satellite in orbit, < 2% of the median for the same days of year in other years; 'reduced' (VIIRS only, judged against another VIIRS) when < 50%. Days with fewer than 100 expected detections are not judged from the data alone; on those days zero detections inside a documented outage notice are flagged as a gap (documented + zero). A month is reduced coverage for a satellite when its flagged days lost >= 5% of the detections expected that month. A flagged run is 'confirmed' when it overlaps a documented NASA/NOAA outage notice, otherwise 'suspected'.

aoiInterval.note: Small-area interval = v·[lo, hi] widened by 1.645·factor·sqrt(v). factor = smallest value reaching 90 % coverage on held-out zone-months of the other years; coverage scored on each held-out year. Validated at zone scale (H3 res-1, ~600,000 km²); smaller areas are not validated separately.
